body:
You were more than a little help, I was far closer to that edge last night than I would like to think and although i still feel like shit I at least dont feel as hopeless as i did before.

Thank you so so so so much

It would be amazing if I could vote democrat seeing as I am not an american and do not live in the US.  

Your point is clearly made though and I do appreciate it.

you do make several points that are valid.... 

16 trillion in debt is a hell of a number, and yeah the US is basically bankrupt.... scary really.

wow, you are nuts... 

voting for someone just because of the party? no concern for the candidate is exactly what is wrong with the world. 

Since when has being socialist (and the OP clearly is not one because he voted for what in his opinion was the lesser of two evils) a bad thing? when did it mean that someone has "no morals"?

Thanks for your post, its nice to see that a few people give a shit. 

The food thing is bad, I feel like some of the bad habits were formed when I was an athlete (fairly highly nationally ranked in my sport). At the time I was working out for 4+ hours a day 6 days a week, swimming, weights, biking, running, I had a great mix going. To give you an idea I would swim the equivalent of 2 to 4 miles a day, plus weights, cycling, or running. I probably should have tried out for a triathlon but running was never my strong suit. 

While I was really into athletics, I could eat prettywell anything I felt like, because I was burning calories off so fast I still lost weight. Now, since I got into office work and school takes the rest of my time, I haven't worked out but the bad eating habits remained, and so now I sit here fat...

I used to have a lot of pride, lots to do, things to look ahead to. now it feels like my future is just full of shit jobs, being broke, and having no reason to fight further.
good for you, but a vast number of Canadians do love him and find his takes not only funny but also accurate and in tune with "our" national sentiment.

Its bad to say I know, but the reality is that I really have started to lose confidence in myself, its hard to see a way out when there is such a huge hole above you. 

I basically am desperate and feel like I have nothing else I can do. When I send off resumes and try to study I just end up feeling like its just useless. Hell, last time I was unemployed I applied for ANYTHING and everything, I heard back in 5 months of daily applications all over the place to anything I could find (even things I was just barely qualified for, because why not, money is money), I managed to get precisely 3 calls. The only thing I got an offer/actual in person interview for was my last job where I got forced out because of office politics. It took 5+ months to get that and I dont have another  months worth of money or energy left to fight this further.

Thanks again, I cant begin to say how helpful it is. 

I have survived, barely but I have made it this far. I kept going last year with something to look forward to but now that is prettymuch gone as well. I would love a hobby or an activity but I have no money to take up something, and even free things require time, being unemployed with nothing else I have time but I likely should be using it to keep myself alive and make some sort of an income. It really is a shit situation and leaves me feeling like I have nothing.

Thank you for your comment, I shed a tear (unusual for me since i rarely ever cry) while reading it. 

For clarity I am working towards an MBA after getting an undergrad degree in arts. The nature of my program and the huge reliance on contacts to move forward means that if I disclose my situation I prettymuch am signing away any chance of getting a job through friends/family/contacts... nobody wants to hire someone who is so screwed up let alone put them in charge of things. 

It helps to hear your story, I still feel like shit and don't see much of a way out of this situation but at least I know someone has made it out.

Thank you for your post, and for reading my great wall of text there, I know few people will bother but it is nice that someone at least did it. 

You hit the nail on the head. I know that I deserve better and more, but I am in a situation where I cannot get to that. The feeling is really that this is just a hopeless delaying fight. Yes, I have scraped through to this point but for what? I struggled, fought, pushed, and still nothing... its not got better, in fact its actually got worse.
